quests.instruction: Listen carefully, then select the word you hear.
quests.hint: 'full' uses a short, relaxed /ʊ/ with light lip rounding; 'fool' stretches the same lip position into a long, tense /uː/.
quests.explanation: The speaker said "full." The vowel /ʊ/ is short, with the lips only loosely rounded. "Fool" would hold the same rounded position much longer for the tense /uː/.
